_comment: check-cg selftest: two repeater instantiations in rtl/top/rpt-units.json's form (tools/gen-top.py), one stage of one 64-bit slot each, one with a 16-bit lead slice and one with none. The lead's first-stage flops, written every cycle, take the instantiation past its allowance; without them it passes.

bench.build: verilator --binary --timing --trace -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Irtl/include -Irtl/generated --top-module tb_cg_rpt -GSTAGES=1 -GS=1 -GW=64 "-GLEAD=64'hffff" --Mdir {dir} -o tb rtl/ccv_assert_pkg.sv rtl/phys/ccv_common_rpt.sv test/cg/tb_cg_rpt.sv

verilator --binary --timing --trace -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Irtl/include -Irtl/generated --top-module tb_cg_rpt -GSTAGES=1 -GS=1 -GW=64 "-GLEAD=64'h0" --Mdir {dir} -o tb rtl/ccv_assert_pkg.sv rtl/phys/ccv_common_rpt.sv test/cg/tb_cg_rpt.sv
